mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the motor routes was most worthwhile because the final picture showed how sensory and motor paths share a spinal nerve but separate at the cord.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the four central regions became a little repetitive: each used neural tissue with a different set of tracts. The individual examples helped distinguish them, though.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the spinal cord has grey matter inside white matter, unlike the outer grey layer shown in the brain regions.

arbitrary.text: No action felt completely arbitrary, but some named regions and tracts were unfamiliar. I could follow the matching openings without understanding all their detailed functions.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the final model leaves the upper-limb branches ready for tissue connections, and I would like to see how they link to the arm.
